preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 1000.
The length of the codes n must be between 1 and 100,000.
The values x and y must satisfy 0 <= x <= y <= n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= b_i <= n + 1 for b_i in b)
preconditions.description: Each color in Bob's guess must be between 1 and n+1.

postconditions.description: The output must be either 'YES' or 'NO' indicating the existence of a valid secret code.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' and len(a) == n and all(1 <= a_i <= n + 1 for a_i in a)
postconditions.description: If the output is 'YES', the secret code must have length n and each color must be between 1 and n+1.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' and x == sum(1 for i in range(n) if a[i] == b[i]) and y == len(set(a) & set(b))
postconditions.description: If the output is 'YES', the values of x and y must match the calculated values based on the secret code and Bob's guess.
